rows.note: Use 講到 as the all-purpose spoken choice when mentioning, discussing, or being about a topic.

example.english: When we refer to this brand, we usually mean the restaurant in Causeway Bay.
example.traditional: 講到呢個品牌，我哋通常係指銅鑼灣嗰間餐廳。
example.jyutping: gong2 dou3 ni1 go3 ban2 paai4 ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 hai6 zi2 tung4 lo4 waan1 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this when handing a matter over to another person or group for consideration or action.

example.english: I’ll refer this complaint to customer service for handling.
example.traditional: 呢宗投訴我會交畀客服處理。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 tau4 sou3 ngo5 wui5 gaau1 bei2 haak3 fuk6 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this when a word, name, or expression denotes or means something.

example.english: The term “individual visit” is used to refer to mainland visitors who travel around Hong Kong on their own.
example.traditional: 呢個詞「自由行」係指內地旅客自己嚟香港玩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci4 zi6 jau4 haang4 hai6 zi2 noi6 dei6 leoi5 haak3 zi6 gei2 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 waan2

rows.note: Use this conversational pattern when directing someone to a particular place or service.

example.english: When customers ask about refunds, I refer them to the service desk.
example.traditional: 客人問退款，我叫佢哋去服務台。
example.jyutping: haak3 jan4 man6 teoi3 fun2 ngo5 giu3 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 fuk6 mou6 toi4
